description: Make printable award certificates: star student, reading, sports, end of year, kindness, completion and more, with a border, a seal and signature lines. Give names to print one certificate per person (in the chat; the link carries no names, as on the site). award_page starts from one of the site’s ready awards.

award_page.description: A ready award page to start from.

date.description: A date to print, e.g. "June 5". Leave out for a blank date line.

date_line.description: Show a date line (blank unless date is given).

dyslexia_font.description: Print in OpenDyslexic, a typeface some readers with dyslexia find easier.

names.description: Optional names, one certificate each (first names are enough). Shown and printed in the chat only: like the site, the link never carries names, so a person opening the link types them on the page.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, the default; US and Canada) or a4 (everywhere else).

presented.description: The line before the name, e.g. "This certificate is proudly presented to".

reason.description: What it is for, under the name, e.g. "for reading 50 books this year".

title.description: The award’s name, e.g. "Star Student" or "Certificate of Achievement".

name: make_certificate

maker.description: Which maker drew it, e.g. wordSearch

notes.description: Things worth knowing about this sheet

playUrl.description: Where a child can solve it on a screen (word search, crossword, maze, sudoku)

seed.description: The seed that rebuilds this exact sheet

settings.description: The address settings, as the maker reads them

url.description: The sheet on printablesmith.com, every setting filled in: open it to adjust, download the PDF or print

title: Certificate
